excerpt: 'The 72 MeV proton beam from the Injector 2 cyclotron enters the Ring from the back and is injected at a radius of 2.1 m.' 'The protons are accelerated in about 180 revolutions and are then extracted at the full energy at a radius of 4.5 m.' The page says nothing about the building.
title: The Ring Cyclotron (PSI, Center for Accelerator Science and Engineering)
